title: Tribal Knowledge AI Reasoning Hardening

units.title: LLMEngine tribal context type
units.details: Added 'tribal' to ContextChunk type union. Enables tribal knowledge to be injected as AI context.

units.title: ProcessAdvice tribal knowledge integration
units.details: Updated processAdvice() to call masterMachinistRecommend() and populate tribal_knowledge[] with senior machinist tips. Lazy imports TribalKnowledgeEngine to avoid circular deps.

units.title: Tribal context provider registration
units.details: Added registerTribalContextProvider() function that registers a context provider pulling top 10 high-confidence tips. Auto-registered on module load (non-blocking).

units.title: TK-AI hardening test suite
units.details: 12 tests covering: tribal context provider, processAdvice tribal integration, Master Machinist AI reasoning, PUOA tribal synthesis, and AI learning loop capture.

units.title: PRISMIntelligenceLayer tribal synthesis
units.details: Added getTribalSynthesis() method and wired into reason() for manufacturing domains. Tribal knowledge now injected into prism_ai reason, speed_feed, tool_select, sequence, strategy, etc. 3 additional tests added.

integration_points.LLMEngine: Tribal context type + registerTribalContextProvider + processAdvice tribal injection
integration_points.TribalKnowledgeEngine: masterMachinistRecommend for AI-ready tips, captureFromLLMReasoning for learning loop
integration_points.PRISMUnifiedOrchestratorEngine: synthesizeTribalForTask for PUOA task execution, queryTribalKnowledge for NL access
integration_points.PRISMIntelligenceLayer: getTribalSynthesis + buildUserPrompt tribal context injection for 11 manufacturing domains

summary: Hardened tribal knowledge integration with PRISM AI/LLM systems. LLMEngine now includes tribal knowledge as context type and auto-injects Master Machinist recommendations. PRISMIntelligenceLayer.reason() now injects tribal synthesis for all manufacturing domains (speed_feed, tool_select, sequence, strategy, etc.). PUOA tribal synthesis validated for task execution. 15 tests covering all integration points.
